description: Select option(s) from a native/custom dropdown, or highlight text inside an element (mode: 'text').

app.description: Electron app name configured in config.json under 'electron'.

end.description: End offset when mode='text' on an input/textarea.

mode.description: 'option' (default) picks dropdown option(s); 'text' highlights text inside the element.

start.description: Start offset when mode='text' on an input/textarea.

value.description: Exact option text/value to select (required for single-option select).

values.description: Multiple option values for multi-select dropdowns.

name: browser_select
